feedback.Physical Object: Excluded — A story arc diagram is a conceptual visualization, not a physical object.
feedback.Synthetic: Included — It is a human-designed abstraction used to model narrative structures.
feedback.Biological/Biomimetic: Excluded — Not biologically derived or inspired.
feedback.Powered: Excluded — Does not require power to exist as a conceptual model.
feedback.Structural: Excluded — Any physical structure comes from external representation.
feedback.Observable: Excluded — Only visible when instantiated in visual form.
feedback.Physical Medium: Excluded — Exists as a conceptual framework independent of medium.
feedback.Active: Excluded — Passive structure that models narrative logic.
feedback.Intentionally Designed: Excluded — Not functionally implemented; its design serves representational purposes.
feedback.Outputs Effect: Excluded — Does not produce outputs unless interpreted.
feedback.Processes Signals/Logic: Excluded — Encodes logic but does not execute it.
feedback.State-Transforming: Excluded — Static representation; does not change on its own.
feedback.Human-Interactive: Excluded — Interaction depends on external tools or representations.
feedback.System-integrated: Excluded — Applicable in systems, but not inherently embedded.
feedback.Functionally Autonomous: Excluded — Not capable of self-directed operation.
feedback.System-Essential: Excluded — Not indispensable to any particular system.
feedback.Symbolic: Included — Represents narrative dynamics using symbolic structure.
feedback.Signalling: Included — Communicates narrative flow and dramatic structure.
feedback.Rule-governed: Included — Follows narrative conventions and plotting heuristics.
feedback.Compositional: Included — Structured through components such as exposition, climax, resolution.
feedback.Normative: Included — Suggests ideal or expected story structure.
feedback.Meta: Included — Describes the architecture of storytelling itself.
feedback.Temporal: Included — Maps progression across narrative time.
feedback.Digital/Virtual: Included — Often exists as a software template or visual abstraction.
feedback.Social Construct: Included — Meaningful only within shared narrative conventions.
feedback.Institutionally Defined: Included — Taught and formalized within literature, media, and education.
feedback.Identity-Linked: Excluded — Not inherently tied to individual identity or roles.
feedback.Regulated: Included — Standardized in narrative theory and media production.
feedback.Economically Significant: Included — Drives structure in storytelling industries (film, TV, publishing).
feedback.Politicised: Included — Narrative structures influence ideological framing and cultural narratives.
feedback.Ritualised: Included — Embedded in storytelling traditions and genre expectations.
feedback.Ethically Significant: Included — Shapes how stories frame justice, agency, and moral themes.

encoding_notes: This encoding treats the story arc diagram as a normative and symbolic abstraction used to represent time-based narrative structure. It is heavily embedded in institutional, cultural, and ethical systems, with no inherent functional behavior.
